changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[ResponsibilityDetail] as select r.ResponsibilityUid, r.RuleID, r.ResponsibilityTypeID, r.ResponsibilityTypeName, r.AssetID, r.AssetTypeID, r.ResourceID, r.ResourceName, iif(SecurityType = 1, 'G', 'R') SecurityAsset, r.SecurityId as SecurityAssetID, iif(SecurityType = 1, GroupName, ResourceName) as SecurityAssetName, r.Context, r.ApplyToType, r.[Permissions] as PermissionsBitMask, r.IsVisible, NULL as OverrideID, A.Object, coalesce(A.ObjectID, 0) as ObjectID, t.Object as [Type], t.ObjectID as TypeID, r.ResourceUid, iif(SecurityType = 1, GroupUid, ResourceUid) as SecurityAssetUid from ResponsibilitySummary r inner join dbo.Asset a on a.Id = r.AssetID inner join dbo.AssetType t on t.Id = r.AssetTypeID
